# Your Electrician

> Your Electrician is a licensed, bonded, and insured electrical contractor serving homes and businesses across the Minneapolis–St. Paul metro area in Minnesota.

## About

Your Electrician is a family-owned electrical business serving homeowners and businesses across the Minneapolis–St. Paul metro area, MN. The team handles residential work such as new home wiring, remodeling, and panel upgrades, plus commercial lighting and EV charger installation. Every project starts with a free estimate and ends with code-compliant, inspected work.

## Services

- [New Home Electrical Wiring](https://yourelectrician.co/home-builds/): Turnkey electrical for new builds and custom homes — service and panels, rough-in to final trim, lighting, and EV/solar prewire.
- [Home Electrical Remodeling](https://yourelectrician.co/home-remodeling/): Circuits, lighting, outlets, and panel upgrades for kitchen, bath, basement, and addition remodels.
- [Commercial Lighting](https://yourelectrician.co/commercial-lighting/): LED retrofits, smart controls, exit and emergency lighting, and maintenance plans for offices, retail, warehouses, and restaurants.
- [EV Charger Installation](https://yourelectrician.co/ev-charger-installation/): Level 2 charging stations for homes and fleets, including load calculations, dedicated 240V circuits, and panel upgrades.
